title: Recruiting Sanya

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Isn’t the light out here something else? The shadows cast by the beams, the way the oil slick turns the waves to rainbows?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn’t the light out here something else? The shadows cast by the beams, the way the oil slick turns the waves to rainbows?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I haven’t stopped taking photos since I got here. None of them relevant to my assignment, but what’s new?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven’t stopped taking photos since I got here. None of them relevant to my assignment, but what’s new?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Sigh. I’m meant to be out here gathering evidence of the Oil Rig’s decline.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sigh. I’m meant to be out here gathering evidence of the Oil Rig’s decline.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: So I’m supposed to capture proof that it’s Category A Hazardous Terrain. But instead I keep seeing the beauty here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I’m supposed to capture proof that it’s Category A Hazardous Terrain. But instead I keep seeing the beauty here.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: But some of them do. To some of them, this is home. Look, help me out. Have you seen anything particularly lethal-looking around?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But some of them do. To some of them, this is home. Look, help me out. Have you seen anything particularly lethal-looking around?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Help me out, have you seen anything particularly lethal looking around?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Help me out, have you seen anything particularly lethal looking around?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: If I don’t they’ll just send someone else. And I’ll be out of a job. So yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I don’t they’ll just send someone else. And I’ll be out of a job. So yes.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Hmm. Maybe the CEOs have a point. What’s the use of this place anyway? No one uses oil anymore, apart from a few longevity clinics. This place is a relic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm. Maybe the CEOs have a point. What’s the use of this place anyway? No one uses oil anymore, apart from a few longevity clinics. This place is a relic.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I know what I am, ok. I spend half my life trying to forget, and the other half making sure I remember. I don’t need lectures from you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know what I am, ok. I spend half my life trying to forget, and the other half making sure I remember. I don’t need lectures from you.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Really? Like who?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Like who?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Yeah, like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, like what?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: ... long-handled paddle things on boats?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... long-handled paddle things on boats?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Was that a pun?? What is WRONG with you? And who the heck are O.R.S?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was that a pun?? What is WRONG with you? And who the heck are O.R.S?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Separatists... so like a movement? You think they'd let me take a photo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Separatists... so like a movement? You think they'd let me take a photo?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I have to be careful with my job. I have to hide my mentoring work as it is. If they found out I joined some kind of society…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to be careful with my job. I have to hide my mentoring work as it is. If they found out I joined some kind of society…

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Yeah. Unfortunately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Unfortunately.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I do! ... Ugh, alright, I'll check this group out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do! ... Ugh, alright, I'll check this group out.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Yeah, right. Look, I gotta get these shots.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, right. Look, I gotta get these shots.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Like the sea is the skin of a huge beast. Can you see it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like the sea is the skin of a huge beast. Can you see it?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Hardly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hardly.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Some Spire-ites have decided it ruins their view.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some Spire-ites have decided it ruins their view.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Activists? For what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Activists? For what?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: But you have to promise not to say a word to ANYBODY on the mainland, ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you have to promise not to say a word to ANYBODY on the mainland, ok?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I can't risk it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't risk it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing out here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing out here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you doing out here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you going to take a photo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you going to take a photo?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you going to take a photo?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you going to take a photo?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your assignment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your assignment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds worthwhile.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds worthwhile.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure the people stuck here would agree with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure the people stuck here would agree with you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure the people stuck here would agree with you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure the people stuck here would agree with you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s why I like it here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s why I like it here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That’s why I like it here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That’s why I like it here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’re going to go through with the assignment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re going to go through with the assignment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You’re going to go through with the assignment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You’re going to go through with the assignment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Spoken like a true Corp sell out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spoken like a true Corp sell out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Spoken like a true Corp sell out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Spoken like a true Corp sell out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Rig does look kind of old in places.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Rig does look kind of old in places.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The Rig does look kind of old in places.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The Rig does look kind of old in places.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you feel bad then do something about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you feel bad then do something about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you feel bad then do something about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you feel bad then do something about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Blow it up, I say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Blow it up, I say.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But there are people who want to save it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But there are people who want to save it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But there are people who want to save it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But there are people who want to save it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you heard of O.R.S?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you heard of O.R.S?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No! O.R.S!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! O.R.S!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oil Rig Separatists.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oil Rig Separatists.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe... if you're a member.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe... if you're a member.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I thought you wanted to capture reality?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought you wanted to capture reality?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I thought you wanted to capture reality?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I thought you wanted to capture reality?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it. Business first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it. Business first.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cross my heart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cross my heart.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And who wants to know this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And who wants to know this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And who wants to know this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And who wants to know this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not lecturing. I'm offering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not lecturing. I'm offering.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Poets. And political activists.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poets. And political activists.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Environmental reasons?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Environmental reasons?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you don't want to give them a try?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you don't want to give them a try?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you don't want to give them a try?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you don't want to give them a try?
